home.heroSubtitle: We design and build props in our own workshop, stock the tools and materials we use every day, and put together producing packs so no shoot ever runs out. If we don't have it, we'll build it for you.
home.missionLead: We exist to make life easier for the people who build the scene: set dressers, art departments, production designers, prop makers and every other film-set professional.
home.m1text: Set dressers, art departments, prop makers... we get you what you need, when you need it, without chasing a dozen suppliers.
home.m2text: The object that doesn't exist, the piece that has to go up in a blackout, the material that must survive a whole tour: we solve it.
home.m3text: Strange, impossible or last-minute ideas. If it can be built, we build it; if it doesn't exist, we invent it.
home.showText: Our own prop designs, workshop tools and materials, tested in real stage conditions.
home.customText: We build one-off pieces for theatre, film, TV and events. Tell us what you need and we'll make it.

custom.title: Custom props
custom.intro: Look at the remarkable things we can make for you. From a hand prop to a full scenography element: we combine technical craft with film-grade finishes to solve whatever you need.
custom.cap3dText: FDM and resin printing for precise parts, replicas and prototypes. We model, print and post-process until the piece disappears on camera.
custom.capMouldText: Silicone moulds and resin casts to make multiple identical copies of an object: safe replicas, fragile or valuable pieces and short runs.
custom.capDesignText: We start from a reference, a sketch or an impossible idea and turn it into a real piece. We prototype, test in use and adjust before the final version.
custom.capFinishText: Scenic painting, patinas, aging, lightweight carpentry and assembly. The finish is what makes an object read as real under the lights.
custom.tech2: Foam and EVA shaping and machining
custom.tech6: Basic electronics: lights, sound and mechanisms
custom.tech8: Safe replicas of fragile or valuable objects
custom.quoteIntro: Tell us what you need and when you need it. We reply within 24-48 working hours.
custom.quoteWhat: What do you need? (dimensions, references, how it's used on stage...)

packs.title: Producing packs
packs.intro: Recurring packs of tools, consumables and materials for film and TV sourcing teams. Pick what you want, how often you want it and for how long: we prep it and ship it to set. A simple way to always have on hand what a shoot burns through, and to discover our products.
packs.how1text: Choose products and quantities, delivery frequency and the length of the production.
packs.how2text: Your request reaches us and we confirm quantities, schedule and billing terms.
packs.how3text: We prep and ship each delivery on a recurring basis. Adjust quantities whenever you like.
packs.configIntro: Add quantities to the products you want in each shipment, then choose frequency and duration. Amounts are a rough estimate (VAT included, shipping not included).
packs.requestHint: We'll open an email with your configured pack for you to send us.
packs.emptyAlert: Add at least one product to the pack before requesting it.
packs.mailIntro: Hi! I'd like to set up a producing pack with these products:
packs.accountText: For recurring packs we'll create an account for your production and set up periodic billing through a secure payment gateway (we never store banking details on this website). Write to us with your configured pack and we'll send you the steps to activate the subscription.
packs.configHelp: The pack is bought for its full duration and delivered gradually, so you don't have to store everything at once.
packs.addProduct: Add any product to the pack
packs.payUpfrontSub: One payment for the whole duration.
packs.nextNote: Later deliveries receive the standard delivery above.

about.title: About us
about.story1: Prop a Prop Teu was born in a workshop where we've spent years solving the practical problems of the stage: the object that doesn't exist anywhere, the piece that must be mounted in a 30-second blackout, the material that has to survive a whole tour.
about.story2: Today we combine two things: a shop with products we design and test ourselves (plus the tools and materials we use every day), and a custom fabrication service for any stage need.
about.what1: Our own designs, tested in real stage conditions before we sell them.
about.what2: A curated selection of workshop tools and materials: we only sell what we'd use ourselves.
about.what3: Custom props for theatre, film, TV and events.
about.values: Every product of our own goes through prototype, real-use testing and review before reaching the shop. If a product says it holds 8 kg, it's because we've hung more weight on it, for longer, than the datasheet claims.
about.faqText: Shipping, returns, VAT, custom commissions... it's all in the frequently asked questions.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.a1: We prepare orders within 24-48 working hours. Delivery takes 2-4 working days in mainland Spain. The Balearic and Canary Islands may take longer.
faq.a2: Yes, you have 14 calendar days from delivery to return any catalogue product. Custom commissions cannot be returned. See the terms of sale for details.
faq.a3: Yes, all prices include Spanish VAT (21%). Shipping is calculated at checkout.
faq.q4: Do you take custom commissions? How does it work?
faq.a4: Yes. Tell us what you need via the custom props form and we'll send a no-obligation quote within 24-48 h. Accepted commissions require a 50% deposit.
faq.a5: Yes, we issue VAT invoices for all orders. Add your tax details at checkout or write to us.
